feature_contract.goal: Keep the complete original title/menu/car-selection custom-sprite quad physically inside the currently published viewport after an old scale survives D3D9Ex Reset, while preserving source art aspect and four-corner affine registration.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only KeepCentered/OnlineArcade contained original custom sprite quad mapping is viewport-capped; Vanilla desktop, original game HUD, F11, ESC, GOAL/+TIME, SkyGlow, R26_SAFE rollback, DX11/DXVK and input/FFB remain unmodified.
trace_stages: Original OutRun title/menu/car-selector custom sprites publish four already transformed corner positions and an independent cached screen_scale after D3DX source vertex transformation.

R84 shared hooks_uiscaling custom sprite producer builds a single source-space affine map; previously the X/Y corner coordinates had separately calculated scale and vertical-centering despite one contained quad.

New R84 source map bounds the four X/Y corners by the live D3D9 destination viewport rather than stale cached screen_scale, leaving untouched D3D9 depth, alpha, original GPU DrawPrimitiveUP and OpenXR compositor surfaces.
subcomponents: Bound contained custom-sprite physical scale to the minimum of positive finite cached source scales and current screen/source width and height ratios; preserve intentional smaller UI zoom.

Route all four original custom-quad Y vertices through the same PixelMap as existing X vertices, and execute native 4:3/16:9/21:9/portrait/Reset-scale mismatch regression in mandatory Windows x64 host build.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Title/menu/car-select original custom sprite visibility and 4-corner geometry
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Contain the authored custom sprite in the physically published viewport even if cached screen scale is too large; all X/Y corners share one centred affine without distortion.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Vanilla original desktop, gameplay HUD and bad/reset source inputs
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Preserve original Vanilla anisotropic X and unchanged uncontained Y, deliberately smaller scales, and reject zero, nonfinite or impossible contained dimensions without altering FFB, SkyGlow, GOAL or DXVK.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Native Windows R84/R26 rollback + x64 OpenXR host smoke, package and domain/source CI
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Release-executed native menu quad smoke and mandatory DX9Ex Active, Domain Isolation, Full Source Impact and affected HUD Inspector jobs pass on the exact validation-bearing commit.

diagnosis.root_cause: The contained source custom quad X transform used BuildPixelMap's cached gameScale while Y recalculated scale/centering independently; when screen_scale is left larger than the published current viewport after D3D9Ex Reset, the old quad extends beyond visible menu and car-selection source bounds.
diagnosis.source_evidence: The existing hooks_uiscaling.cpp assigned all four X with ProjectX(quadMap), but four Y vertices used an independent scaleY and verticalCenter from screen_scale; BuildPixelMap contained branch never capped gameScale by destination width/source width and height/source height.
diagnosis.original_evidence: Original game title/menu/selector and custom-sprite corner producers remain canonical, with original DrawPrimitiveUP, UV/depth/color and D3DX vertex transformed positions unmodified.
source_trace: The original title/menu/selector game custom sprite source provides four corners transformed by its own D3DX matrix and cached original resolution.
The R84 custom sprite hook constructs PixelMap with both game scale and current backbuffer extent and now projects all eight X/Y corner coordinates consistently.
The D3D9 original DrawPrimitiveUP still submits exactly one four-vertex quad; the OpenXR host inherits original per-eye presentation, not an artificially moved world render.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: This correction is a contained original game UI geometry/viewport contract upstream of the same original D3D9 GPU draw; binocular user acceptance requires matching Quest3/VDXR visual confirmation.
alternatives_rejected: GOAL/+TIME deferred-batch ownership cannot repair physically cropped original car-selector art in a contained resize transition.
Adding a second generic XR crop or modifying all mono world/HUD draws would risk unrelated healthy stereo and does not fix inconsistent original four-corner geometry.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Physical screen/source scale caps the previously unbounded contained cached scaling, and the original quad now uses ProjectY(quadMap) for each of the four corners just as it already used ProjectX.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: New native Release smoke covers old-size-to-new-size scale mismatch, square/portrait 4:3/16:9/21:9 positions, smaller scale preservation, Vanilla desktop, invalid/NaN/tiny inputs and transformed corners.

next_action: C5 exact-SHA integration underway. Initial material-only commit was blocked in pre-build feature policy due to absent required run record; same-task error repair adds record without weakening gate or touching game C++ again. Quest3/VDXR runtime remains UNTESTED.
